prompt.alinti: You can now drop raw clips in a folder, and Claude edits the final video. It's called Video Use, and it cuts out every um, uh, and dead pause between your takes. Because Claude never watches the video, it reads a word-by-word transcript, so every cut lands between two words. Then, it color grades every clip and burns in captions in your style. And get this, it checks its own render at every cut before it shows you anything. But it needs an ElevenLabs API key to write that transcript. For the repo link, comment 'edit'.

yontem.ne: Klasik video düzenlemeyi otomatikleştirir, transkript tabanlı kesim yapar ve renk gradyanı ekler.

akis.ne: Kullanıcı klip dosyalarını bir klasöre ekler.

akis.ne: Claude, transkript okur ve klipleri kelime-kelime keser.
